Loyalty

“Forever” Loyalty challenges

Set Challenge end to No end date so an always-on challenge can continue without expiring.

Available September 1, 2026
See official release notes →
Why it helps

Keep evergreen engagement programs running without repeatedly recreating or extending the challenge.

Loyalty

Loyalty now available to more shield customers

Journey Optimizer Loyalty is now available to Healthcare Shield and Privacy and Security Shield customers.

Available September 15, 2026
See official release notes →
Why it helps

More eligible teams can bring challenge-based engagement into their customer programs.

Loyalty Insights skill

CX Coworker can answer questions about challenge performance and other loyalty-program data ingested into Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty field groups.

Why it helps

Use conversational analysis to understand challenge performance without starting from a manual report.

Five Loyalty updates to plan around

Pre-releaseLoyalty
Challenge Opportunities

An Opportunities tab will surface AI-detected loyalty trends and gaps, with projected impact and a one-click Create with AI action.

Target: Sep 22–23, 2026
Pre-releaseLoyalty
Loyalty event mapping updates

A visual mapping builder will support schema and field selection, mapping status, JSONata preview, and renamed Event Mappings.

Target: Sep 22–23, 2026
Pre-releaseLoyalty
Coworker loyalty recommendation skill

Ask Coworker for grounded challenge opportunities based on real program trends, then turn them into live challenges from chat.

Target: Sep 22–23, 2026
Pre-releaseLoyalty
Challenge data in Content Card personalization

The Challenges domain will make challenge metadata available for launch, in-progress, and end-stage Content Card personalization without custom code.

Target: Sep 22–23, 2026
Pre-releaseLoyalty
Per-member completion deadlines

Set a completion window from each member’s opt-in date; when a challenge end date also exists, the earlier deadline applies.

Target: Sep 22–23, 2026
